## Example

```qml

    id: scroller
    anchors.fill: parent
    Column { /* tall content */ }
```

## API

Style-only control: no extra QWinUI3 properties. Use the Qt Quick Controls `ScrollView` API (this file only supplies Fluent visuals / metrics).
